UserComment.Text: The filter and pulse on the melody is just stunning. Also I don't think anyone consistently nailed the start of C64 tunes like Reyn did.
Simply a awesome tune by Reyn Ouwehand!
What a brilliant tune. I could listen to it forever... What's with Lars these days, does anyone know?
This sid was used in a Danish version of the game "Wheel of Fortune" (in Danish: Lykkehjulet). I can't find the game anywhere but I'm pretty sure that the sid was made for the game.
Great tune which I to this day still find myself humming every now and then.
Carsten, congrats to this phenomenal track. I adored it back in time and I have used it for my Illusion intro...

My old tunes from 1988-1990 were made on 6581 SID - recently I discovered that using "Trurl6581R3_4885" filter emulation in Sidplay2 gives the tunes much of the original sound back. So if you liked my Galactix V2.0 or the title theme from our Combat Zone game (subtune 5) from 1990... please select this filter if you use emulation of 6581 SID.
Always loved this one. I probably used it in some intro or so.
